amendment_reason: Independent Codex review found four fail-closed defects in the source-acquisition utility. Harden the offline plan, quote receipt, resumable manifest, and single-writer paid boundary before any further remote operation.
required_fixes: Validate every persisted plan window byte-for-byte against the frozen clock-derived canonical window before any remote call.
Reconcile quote receipt quotes, totals, dataset/schema/symbol, SDK, clock, bindings, and outcome-boundary fields exactly against the quoted plan.

Validate any existing download manifest against schema, plan, unique canonical identities, on-disk DBN existence, byte count, SHA-256, record validation, and charged-empty evidence before any paid call or completion claim.

Acquire an exclusive filesystem lock for the entire paid download critical section so a second process fails before any remote paid call. The lock must be rooted under the approved D-side data directory and released on normal or exceptional exit.
red_first_acceptance_tests: A timestamp-shifted but offset-consistent window with recomputed plan_id fails before metadata or time-series calls.
A mutated receipt quote or total with recomputed receipt_id fails exact reconciliation.
Wrong-plan, duplicate, missing-file, corrupt-file, hash-mismatch, and unvalidated-empty manifest states fail before any paid call.
Two concurrent download workers cannot both cross the paid boundary; only the lock owner may call timeseries.get_range.
All existing focused tests remain green and the persisted offline plan is regenerated with the final tool SHA and deterministic plan ID.
prohibitions: Do not call any remote Databento endpoint in this hardening task.
Do not make any paid, batch, or time-series request.
Do not read EURUSD prices, economic outcomes, or 2023+ holdout data.
Do not create MQL5, compile, backtest, run MT5, or change hypothesis logic/gates.
Do not modify registry, preregistration, frozen clock, clock manifest, V1/V2/V3 packets, workspace docs, or unrelated files.
Do not stage, commit, push, create a branch, worktree, or clone.
handoff: Return changed file hashes, red/green evidence, exact tests run, offline plan ID, registry validator result, and attestation that remote and paid call counts are zero.
